{{Quote|Your victims were wrong, Uda-Khalid. It was a small target, but you had a heart after all.|Jedi Knight Mace Windu after slaying Uda-Khalid|<ref name="Survivors" />}}
'''Uda-Khalid''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] mass [[Death/Legends|killer]] active during the [[Great Peace of the Republic]]. The criminal murdered members of a wide range of [[Species/Legends|species]] in pursuit of power, but was able to escape justice due to his policy of never leaving survivors, which erased any evidence of his actions. Between approximately [[58 BBY/Legends|58 BBY]] and [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] [[Mission to Uda-Khalid's headquarters|dispatched]] the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to serve justice upon Khalid, who had retreated to a [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Uda-Khalid's headquarters|fortress]].

Windu confronted Khalid inside the latter's headquarters, where the murderer initially believed Windu to be a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and continued to deny any wrongdoing. Windu revealed that he knew of the humanoid's crimes as he became surrounded by the [[Ghost (folklore)/Legends|spirits]] of Khalid's many victims. Khalid challenged the Jedi to a duel, wielding a pair of [[Fire blade/Legends|fire blades]] against Windu's [[Mace Windu's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The duel between the two was brief, resulting in a victory for Windu when he stabbed Khalid directly in his [[Heart/Legends|heart]].

==Biography==
===Murderer on the run===
{{Quote|Your victims didn't have to survive to tell me of the evil committed against them.|Mace Windu, to Uda-Khalid|<ref name="Survivors" />}}
[[File:Uda-Khalids_victims.png|thumb|right|200px|Uda-Khalid's victims included a range of different species (spirits depicted).]]
Uda-Khalid was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Alien/Legends|alien]] who became one of the most prominent criminals during the [[Great Peace of the Republic]]. He was known to massacre entire populations in order to obtain power and resources.<ref name="CSWE" /> Khalid destroyed [[City/Legends|cities]] and [[Death/Legends|decimated]] whole [[Species/Legends|species]]; his victims included [[Anx/Legends|Anx]], [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]], [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]], [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]], [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]], [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]], [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]], [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], [[Kitonak/Legends|Kitonaks]], [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]], [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]], [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], and [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. Due to Khalid's policy to never leave survivors, the memory of his victims disappeared from public knowledge and was forgotten by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] authorities. At one point, Khalid was accused of numerous crimes, in spite of his covering up of evidence. This led him to retreat to a [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Unidentified jungle world (Uda-Khalid)|terrestrial body]] to escape justice, residing inside a [[Uda-Khalid's headquarters|fortress]] protected by guards loyal to him.<ref name="Survivors" />

At some point between approximately [[58 BBY/Legends|58 BBY]] and [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> by which point Khalid believed he had successfully evaded punishment,<ref name="Survivors" /> the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] [[Mission to Uda-Khalid's headquarters|dispatched]]<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to bring Uda-Khalid to justice. Windu was contacted by the spirits of Khalid's victims and thus aware of his crimes. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight travelled to Uda-Khalid's headquarters and infiltrated the temple by [[Force jump/Legends|jumping]] past the murderer's gigantic [[walk worm]]s and [[Mind trick/Legends|mind tricking]] two of his guards, a [[Unidentified Human guard (Uda-Khalid)|Human]] and a [[Unidentified Gotal guard|Gotal]]. Inside the temple, Khalid, believing Windu to be a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], offered to double the payment for killing him. Windu countered that he had been paid with the stories of Khalid's victims, which the mass killer refuted due to the lack of evidence for his crimes.<ref name="Survivors" />

===Duel to the death===
{{Quote|How did you&mdash;I've never seen&mdash;So fast&hellip;|Uda-Khalid after being fatally stabbed by Mace Windu|<ref name="Survivors" />}}
[[File:Windu_Battles_Khalid.png|thumb|left|300px|Uda-Khalid challenged Mace Windu to a duel.]]
Windu challenged Khalid's assertion as the [[Ghost (folklore)/Legends|spirits]] of the murderer's many victims appeared in the interior and exterior of the fortress. He explained that his victims had been able to inform Windu of Khalid's crimes. Khalid continued to dismiss Windu as a bounty hunter and questioned who he was to stand in judgement, Windu responded by identifying his [[Oneness/Legends|oneness]] with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and revealed his name and rank. Khalid claimed that it had been a long time since he had killed a Jedi and activated his dual [[Fire blade/Legends|fire blades]], prompting Windu to activate his [[Mace Windu's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Survivors" />

Khalid repeatedly swung at Windu without striking him or his [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] as the Jedi dodged his attacks. During<ref name="Survivors" /> the swift duel,<ref name="CSWE" /> Windu asserted that Khalid had lied about killing a Jedi, as those in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Order]] would have [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] it due to their connection to all life. As Windu finished speaking, his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] pierced Khalid's [[Heart/Legends|heart]], and the humanoid dropped to his [[Limb/Legends|knees]] while clutching his chest and expressing shock at Windu's speed and mercilessness. Windu stated that Khalid's victims had been wrong about him, as he did indeed have a heart. Khalid looked down at the hole in his chest and coughed up [[Blood/Legends|blood]] before collapsing dead on the floor,<ref name="Survivors" /> ending his reign of terror.<ref name="CSWE" /> Windu looked down on Khalid's corpse, no longer surrounded by the spirits of his victims.<ref name="Survivors" /> The story of Windu's confrontation with Khalid spread throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] along with tales of several of the Jedi's other exploits.<ref name="CSWE Windu>{{CSWECite|III|331|Windu, Mace}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|But you should know that I did not commit the crimes I am blamed for. There was no evidence. None. No survivors. No witnesses.|Uda-Khalid, to Mace Windu|<ref name="Survivors" />}}
[[File:Uda-Khalid_fire_blade.png|thumb|right|250px|Uda-Khalid ready for his duel with Mace Windu]]
A mass killer, Uda-Khalid regarded other people like [[Glass/Legends|glass]], seeing right through them to focus on the power he could obtain. This also meant that he murdered individuals, destroy cities and decimate whole species to further his goals. He showed no respect for traditions, tearing them up like paper. Khalid believed that his policy to never leave survivors meant that there was no evidence of his crimes and that he would escape suspicion and punishment. When confronted by Windu, Khalid offered to double the price on his head, mistaking the Jedi for a bounty hunter. The murderer continued to deny any wrongdoing when challenged, and lied about having experience in killing Jedi before dueling Windu. According to the Jedi Knight, the spirits of Khalid's victims believed he was heartless, a point the Jedi contradicted by fatally stabbing the murderer in his physical heart.<ref name="Survivors" />

Khalid was a large [[Gender/Legends|male]] humanoid with [[Color/Legends|white]] skin and yellow stripes across the back of his head, chin, neck, and arms. He had a row of short horns protruding from his forehead and bald skull, along with drooping black [[Hair/Legends|eyebrows]] that extended downwards to frame his face.<ref name="CSWE" /> Khalid also had sharp black fingernails and oozed brown [[Blood/Legends|blood]] when injured.<ref name="Survivors" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|Khalid does not sign his acts of violence, nor would he risk the seeds of rebellion that are grown from the blood of martyrs.|Uda-Khalid's Human guard|<ref name="Survivors" />}}
Uda-Khalid was capable of ensuring that there were no living survivors or evidence of his murders. In his duel with Mace Windu, Khalid lunged towards the Jedi and made several strikes with his fire blades, although he was unable to hit his target<ref name="Survivors" /> and was swiftly defeated.<ref name="CSWE" />

==Equipment==
Uda-Khalid wielded a set of potent fire blades on his right forearm.<ref name="NEGTWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> He possessed sufficient resources to protect himself in his fortress, including defensive measures such as guards and walk worms. When he encountered Mace Windu, Khalid was wearing dark green robes with a brown vest and both brown and orange sashes. His outfit also included an orange and black patterned fabric that extended from the sashes.<ref name="Survivors" />

==Behind the scenes==
Uda-Khalid appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic story]] "[[Survivors (comic story)|Survivors]]," which was written by [[Jim Krueger]] and illustrated by [[Kagan McLeod]]. The comic story appeared in the Mace Windu-centered [[Star Wars Tales 13|thirteenth issue]] of the anthology series ''[[Star Wars Tales]]'',<ref name="Survivors" /> published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[September 25]], [[2002]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/11-898/Star-Wars-Tales-13|text=Star Wars Tales #13}}</ref>
